newsitem.title: UK: Carpetright tumbles as Hoare cuts forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Carpetright tumbles as Hoare cuts forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Carpetright Plc tumbled on Wednesday to their lowest level for over a year as analysts at brokerage ABN AMRO Hoare Govett lowered their fiscal 1998 profit forecast, dealers said.
The shares dropped 25p to 497-1/2p by 1215 GMT in volume of 240,000 shares.
Market sources said that the brokerage has cut its pre-tax profit forecast for the year ending March 1998 to 41.15 million stg from 43.15 million.
Sources said the reduction reflected a negative view on durable goods retailers, though analysts at the brokerage were not available for comment.
